具有干净的主题提取控制的引导视频键控。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外— 在本地镜像之前在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用— 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则很有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配— 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时— 您希望完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望— 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

此引导式工作流程可帮助您通过精确控制提取干净的视频前景。专为编辑和合成人员设计，它将粗糙的蒙版细化为光滑的遮罩。您可以准确地将拍摄对象从复杂的场景中分离出来，而不会出现边缘伪影。它专为实景编辑而设计，可提高合成清晰度并节省清理时间。非常适合寻求可立即投入生产并具有可调节抠图响应能力的抠像结果的创作者。

重要节点：

Comfyui CorridorKey ComfyUI 工作流程中的关键节点

走廊钥匙(#28)

这是将粗略指南转变为可用于生产的遮罩和前景的核心部分。将引导遮罩视为主要转向信号：如果太紧，您可能会剪掉头发和运动模糊，如果太松，关键帧可能会渗入背景。使您的输入色彩空间在印版和掩模上保持一致，并依赖于质量控制输出以在导出之前判断边缘完整性。当精炼棘手的镜头时，迭代粗略的蒙版，而不是过度调整下游步骤。

图像到蒙版(#31)

该节点从蒙版剪辑中提取单通道遮罩。将其通道选择器与遮罩的编码方式相匹配，例如用于纯红色图形的红色或用于颜色编码遮罩的适当通道。如果您的蒙版是灰度的，请选择适合亮度的通道，以便白色代表主体，黑色代表背景。这里干净的二进制或接近二进制的输入极大地提高了 CorridorKey 的稳定性。

注释

CorridorKey ComfyUI 工作流程 |引导键控和抠图控制— 参见舒适运行页面了解最新的节点要求。

Guided video keying with clean subject extraction control.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning — you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises— run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout— useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON— the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense— you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations— First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

This guided workflow helps you extract clean video foregrounds with precise control. Designed for editors and compositors, it refines coarse masks into smooth mattes. You can accurately separate subjects from complex scenes without edge artifacts. Built for live-action editing, it enhances compositing clarity and saves cleanup time. Perfect for creators seeking production-ready keying results with adjustable matting responsiveness.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in Comfyui CorridorKey ComfyUI workflow

CorridorKey(#28)

This is the centerpiece that transforms a rough guide into a production-ready matte and foreground. Treat the guide mask as the main steering signal: if it is too tight you may clip hair and motion blur, and if it is too loose the key can creep into the background. Keep your input color space consistent across the plate and mask, and rely on theQCoutput to judge edge integrity before exporting. When refining tricky shots, iterate on the coarse mask rather than over-tweaking downstream steps.

ImageToMask(#31)

This node extracts a single-channel matte from the mask clip. Match its channel selector to how your mask is encoded, for example red for solid-red graphics or the appropriate channel for color-coded mattes. If your mask is grayscale, select the luminance-appropriate channel so white represents subject and black represents background. A clean binary or near-binary input here greatly improves CorridorKey’s stability.
